desc: Real, crispy corn Chex cereal pieces in a chocolatey brownie coating with a delightful powdery smooth finish. Individually packaged in a 4.5 oz format, a great sweet treat for the grab-and-go convenience store patron, with 60% less fat than potato chips.
features:
• Real, crispy corn Chex cereal pieces in a chocolatey brownie coating with a delightful powdery smooth finish.

  • 7 Individually packaged bags in a 4.5 oz format for ease of placement in convenience store salty sets.

  • This unique combination of sweet and salty helps bring something for everyone to love to convenience store salty sets.

  • Muddy Buddies have 50% less fat than Potato Chips and make for a great sweet and salty alternative.
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Sugar, Dextrose, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil, Cocoa Powder, Modified Corn Starch. Contains 2% or less of: Cocoa Processed With Alkali, Salt, Soy Lecithin, Corn Starch, Milk Powder, Distilled Monoglycerides, Baking Soda, Yellow Corn Flour, Artificial Flavor.
